leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js application that implements a distributed lock mechanism
Initialize a Redis client to serve as the lock storage backend
Implement lock acquisition logic with expiration to prevent deadlocks
Apply lock release functionality to free resources after job completion
Configure error handling for lock failures and race conditions
Integrate the distributed lock into a sample critical job processing function
Manipulate lock parameters such as timeout and retry intervals
lessonTitle: Build distributed lock for critical jobs
